answer: The basalt graph is rebuilt each epoch, which means the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the fable audit merges it again. Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the orchard checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 7 times its size, so a group of 57 keys loses far more than 57 single identities would. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
